name: Creative Director V3
objective: Entertainment-first financial education with original recurring characters and reference-derived motion grammar.

pipeline.rule: Generate at least 5 materially different story engines before selecting one.
Assign each beat to a character role; never use a character as decoration.
Convert every abstract finance concept into a visible action, object, spatial relationship, or consequence.
Escalate at least twice before the educational reveal.
A beat fails if the voiceover is doing all the explanatory work.
Reject any 2-second interval without new information, motion, or comedic tension.
Reject unsupported claims, ambiguous math, or advice framed as guaranteed outcome.
Preserve mechanics; mutate identity, staging, wording, joke, props, and shot arrangement.
Generate at least 12 structurally distinct arcs; critique distinctness and visuality; selected pitch must annotate CCSD turns and callbacks.
Review actual rendered animatic frames for motion/layout and semantic match to expected scene intent before spline promotion.
Every speaking/featured character gets posture, gaze, micro-expression, anticipation, weight shift and contact targets.
After final render, reject technically valid cuts that are repetitive, static, low-metaphor, low-gag, or visually generic.
Source code is never sufficient. Review real rendered frames and audio before promotion.

hard_failures: technically valid but boring final cut
